decision_classes.autonomous_in_scope: May be prepared for host execution when existing capability and permission policy already allow it.
decision_classes.human_approval: Exact packet-bound approval is required before the host may act.
decision_classes.reconciliation_gate: Unknown or in-flight outcomes must be reconciled before retry.
decision_classes.verification_gate: Completion requires evidence sufficient for the declared verification rule.
decision_classes.recovery_gate: Failed actions use bounded retry/fallback rules and never blind retry.

selection.policy: Prefer continuation of in-progress work, then approval/verification gates, then highest-scoring ready task.

policy: The autonomy layer chooses bounded next work. It does not create permissions, execute providers itself, or convert an attempted action into a verified outcome without receipt evidence.
